main.description: Dial-back test a node runs before it starts relaying. The relay probes the caller's observed IP only, never an address the caller supplies. Requires a node-signed JWT.

nonce.description: Used as the STUN transaction ID of the UDP probe, so the caller's listener can recognize it.

udpPort.description: Port of the caller's STUN/TURN listener. The relay sends a STUN Binding request here.

tcpPort.description: Port of the caller's HTTPS or TURN-over-TCP listener. The relay tries to connect here.

observedIp.description: The caller's IP as the relay saw it.

udpReachable.description: Whether the UDP probe got a valid response. Absent if udpPort wasn't given.

tcpReachable.description: Whether the TCP connection succeeded. Absent if tcpPort wasn't given.
